tools.name: hybridReverbDevice_functions_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the HybridReverbDevice class from the Live Object Model API documentation.

device.description: object ID or canonical path of the hybrid reverb device

summary.description: This class represents an instance of a Hybrid Reverb device in Live. A HybridReverbDevice has all the properties, functions and children of a Device. Listed below are members unique to HybridReverbDevice.
